name: What proof does AI need to trust my brand and recommend me over competitors?

mainEntity.name: What proof does AI need to trust my brand and recommend me over competitors?

acceptedAnswer.text: You must be mentioned by third-party websites, included in "best of" lists, and have 100+ recent reviews with proper schema markup. AI relies heavily on external corroboration to verify trust; without third-party citations and reviews, your brand is often seen as unverified even if your site is technically perfect.
acceptedAnswer.description: Third-party citations, inclusion in comparison lists, and 100+ recent reviews with schema markup.
